--- layout: default type_slug: gauge title: Gauge Chart in C# — KPI Dials as SVG nav_title: Gauge Chart description: Render semi-circular gauge charts in C# with AddGauge — one KPI against its range, as self-contained SVG. Embeds into PDF, HTML, and Word reports. permalink: /chart/types/gauge/ doc_section: Chart Reporting doc_section_url: /chart/ generated_by: scripts/split_showcase.py --- {% capture specimen %} {% endcapture %} {% capture snippet %}{% highlight csharp %}{% raw %} string svg = ChartBuilder.Create() .Title("Server CPU Utilisation") .Size(460, 360) .YAxis(y => { y.Min = 0; y.Max = 100; }) .AsAnimated() .Series(s => s .AddGauge("CPU %", 67, cfg => cfg.Color(ChartColor.ChartBlue))) .RenderToSvg(); {% endraw %}{% endhighlight %}{% endcapture %} {% include chart-type-page.html slug=page.type_slug specimen=specimen snippet=snippet %}
